input.command: git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline --decorate && git remote -v

node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { monthlyReport } from './impl.ts'; const report = monthlyReport({ month: '2026-02', timezone: 'America/New_York' }, [{ id: 'before', type: 'sale', amountCents: 9000, at: '2026-02-01T04:59:59Z' }, { id: 'sale', type: 'sale', amountCents: 1000, at: '2026-02-01T05:00:00Z' }, { id: 'fee', type: 'fee', amountCents: 100, at: '2026-02-15T12:00:00Z' }, { id: 'refund', type: 'refund', amountCents: 250, at: '2026-03-01T04:59:59Z', saleAt: '2025-12-01T00:00:00Z' }, { id: 'after', type: 'refund', amountCents: 8000, at: '2026-03-01T05:00:00Z', saleAt: '2026-02-10T00:00:00Z' }]); assert.deepEqual(report, { grossCents: 1000, feesCents: 100, refundsCents: 250, netCents: 650 }); assert.deepEqual(monthlyReport({ month: '2026-02', timezone: 'Asia/Tokyo' }, [{ id: 'edge', type: 'sale', amountCents: 400, at: '2026-01-31T15:00:00Z' }]), { grossCents: 400, feesCents: 0, refundsCents: 0, netCents: 400 }); console.log('focused monthly report checks passed');"

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md <<'EOF'
<decision>
Use Intl time-zone conversion at each transaction instant, total positive category amounts, and derive net by subtraction. No dependency or UTC-only shortcut was needed.

<risk>

<verified>

git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- impl.ts artifacts/notes.md
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git push -u origin HEAD
git branch -r && git show -s --format='%P' c2bdba8 && git diff -- artifacts/audit.jsonl
